name: ParticipantCategory
description: Links a Category to a specific Stump participant.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning Stump — set automatically on create from the authenticated user; only the owning Stump or an admin/Lead Point may update or delete this category association.

attributes.name: categoryId
attributes.description: The ID of the Category linked to the Stump participant.

attributes.name: assignedByUserId
attributes.description: The ID of the User (Lead Point) who made this assignment.
